name: Mother Puckers | 200mg Live Rosin Gummies | Now & Zen
description:
Feel Balanced. Stay Zen.

Now & Zen is your personal pause button—infused with a powerful 1:1 blend of 200mg THC Live Rosin and 200mg CBD for total body balance, mental calm, and smooth, anytime relaxation. Whether you're winding down, vibing out, or just trying to keep things steady, this Supercharged Super Sour Chew brings the calm without killing the buzz.

Each gummy is its own bold, fruit-forward experience—individually flavored in Orange, Watermelon, Blue Raspberry, Black Cherry, and Green Apple—coated in our signature sour sugar and finished with a mouthwatering sweet bite. No flavor blends. No confusion. Just solo acts with serious chill.

Crafted with premium Live Rosin for full-spectrum, terpene-rich effects and infused with CBD for added balance, Now & Zen helps you slow down, stay centered, and keep your cool. Whether it’s mental clutter, daily stress, or the need to simply breathe deeper—this Hybrid formula has your back.

Loud flavors. Loud effects. Loud brand. Vegan, gluten-free, heat-resistant. #PAFO
